subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding bonds as a way of lending money to a government or company in exchange for interest
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays lending simulated money via a 'bond' and receiving it back with interest after a set time
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a bond scenario to who is borrowing and who is lending
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what a bond is and how it differs from owning a stock

misconception_flags: confuses buying a bond (lending money) with buying a stock (owning part of a company)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
